main_body: A bare, gnarled dead tree: a thick trunk with a wide base plate, branching into several bare limbs. There is no canopy.
top_band: none. The column at x=24 runs from the outline through bark tones (L 74, 42, 74) down to the trunk, with no horizontal top surface. The trunk has no cap and ends at the branches.
evidence: This is an organic tree, drawn as a natural silhouette with a vertical trunk and limbs. The contract is built for standing objects with a top surface, and a bare trunk has none: the scan shows only bark bands, and the base plate at rows 60-62 is a thin 3-row strip. Neither the guide nor the references give a top band here. The strict rule is to fail when in doubt, and no top band can be pointed to, so the piece fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 7 distinct colours and a median of 5 per tile, against 108-109 per tile and 427-567 colours in the references. 93% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is near-black rather than a tinted material tone. The bark has roughly 3 brown steps (L 74, 42, 30) in repeating stripes, with little grain, and there is no canopy or leaf-clump shading. It looks much thinner and more sticker-like than the lush references. The 5x5 flat-fill coverage is 0%, but only because the stripes are narrow, so this does not offset the shallow ramps.
